clips.title: The story
paras: The Kolkar threaten Horde lands from their stronghold in Desolace. Regthar Deathgate sends Horde champions west across the mountains to reinforce scout Felgur Twocuts at Ghost Walker Post.

Centaur raiders keep pressing into the Barrens, and Regthar Deathgate knows that fighting them there will not end the threat. The Kolkar clan draws its strength from the rugged lands on Kalimdor's western coast. While their ancestral stronghold remains beyond Horde control, raiders will keep pouring through the mountain passes. To stop them, the Horde must strike at their home.

Ghost Walker Post gives the Horde a foothold deep in Desolace. Scout Felgur Twocuts watches the rival centaur clans from the outpost. Regthar sends seasoned fighters from the Barrens to serve under Felgur, carrying the Horde's campaign west from defense to direct action.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Kolkar centaur live in Desolace, and their forces have spread into the Barrens. This is a known fact and we have Horde agents dealing with them here.
But as long as the centaur are strong in Desolace, they will always pose a threat. It is time we rid ourselves of that threat.
Speak with Felgur Twocuts at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace. He was sent to gather intelligence on the centaur. He will know how to best deal with the Kolkar of Desolace.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You are here on orders from Regthar? Then you are here to deal with the centaur. Good.
I hope you're rested. I don't know how our campaign against the centaur will end, but I know the struggle will be long.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
